teaser: A startup needs time before money. Start from your own revenue, start while employed, ask for part time, and treat debt as buying time. Avoid regret.
core_idea: Funding a startup is first a question of time: a founder should find it in the work and job they already have, make their existing revenue stream more effective, negotiate part time if they can, and treat savings, exits and debt as ways to buy time, taking investment only later.
